title: ornithogalum umbellatum subsp. baeticum
intro: Ornithogalum umbellatum subsp. baeticum, commonly known as Star of Bethlehem, is a plant species in the Asparagaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The health benefits of Ornithogalum umbellatum subsp. baeticum include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
